entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yeah, it's VF886-092125. For some cycling shoes.

Got it. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes, delivered on September 19th. Before we proceed, could you tell me what the issue is? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
They're awful. I tried setting the cleats, but they just never felt right, and the shoes gave me blisters. I just want my money back.
I understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check our return eligibility for you.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order, and it looks like you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Fine. So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, we'll issue the refund to your original payment method.
Right. Took long enough to figure that out.
I do apologize for the trouble you had with the shoes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
